items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then… maybe the lawyer that we had… Noel Silverman?

ctx.x: Oh, I guess, yeah. Yeah, it probably had to do with getting royalties from recordings and that sort of thing. And yeah, John might have advised me. “Dummy, you gotta,” you know, (laughs) “get a company.” And then… maybe the lawyer that we had… Noel Silverman?
